findings.evidence: grep '^@\[expose\] public section|^public section' over EpsilonEridani/Particles and EpsilonEridani/Relativity: `GPD/Basic.lean:30`, `GPD/Moments.lean:39`, `GPD/Polynomiality.lean:74`, `GPD/DoubleDistribution.lean:65`, `GPD/Ambiguity.lean:52`, `Relativity/CliffordAlgebraExtensions.lean:51`, `Relativity/Tensors/RealTensor/Metrics/LeviCivita.lean:21` all expose; only the three new files (`GPD/Kinematics.lean:56`, `Vector/MinkowskiProductExtensions.lean:19`, `Vector/Causality/BasicExtensions.lean:21`) do not. grep ':= (rfl)' matches exactly 6 occurrences, all in the new files.
findings.fix: Change the three new files to `@[expose] public section` and delete the six `:= (rfl)` lemmas; replace the in-file `rw [avgMomentum_def, delta_def]`/`rw [frameVector_def]` uses with `rw [avgMomentum, delta]`/`simp [frameVector]`, which the file's own proofs already do for `tMin` (`rw [tMin]` at 85 and 92, `simp [tMin]` at 76 and 80).
findings.issue: Six lemmas restate their definitions up to defeq, needed only because the file opens with bare `public section` (line 56): `tMin_def` (72), `avgMomentum_def` (137), `delta_def` (142), `t_def` (147), `skewness_def` (152), and `frameVector_def` (MinkowskiProductExtensions.lean:31). Every other file in `Particles/` and `Relativity/` uses `@[expose] public section`, under which these are redundant.

findings.evidence: diff header `new file mode 100644 EpsilonEridani/Relativity/Tensors/RealTensor/Vector/MinkowskiProductExtensions.lean`, versus the description sentence quoted above; `Glob` confirms the path exists only as this PR's new file.
findings.fix: Confirm against #84 and keep one module: either add `frameVector`, `minkowskiProduct_frameVector`, `frameVector_sub_frameVector` to the module #84 introduces, or move them to a distinct path (e.g. alongside `Causality/BasicExtensions.lean`), and update the description to match the files actually added.
findings.issue: The PR description states the Physlib-level helper "is deliberately not the `Vector/MinkowskiProductExtensions.lean` that open PR #84 creates, so the two PRs don't conflict", but the diff creates exactly `EpsilonEridani/Relativity/Tensors/RealTensor/Vector/MinkowskiProductExtensions.lean` — a second module claiming the same path. (The description is stale in the same way for the other file: it names `Causality/LightLikeExtensions.lean` and `minkowskiProduct_self_nonpos_of_orthogonal_lightLike`, while the diff has `Causality/BasicExtensions.lean` and `..._of_orthogonal_causal`.)

summary: The mathematics is new and reuses upstream API, but the three new files drop the `@[expose] public section` used by every other file in `Particles/` and `Relativity/`, forcing six `(rfl)` `_def` lemmas that restate the definitions verbatim; and the new `Vector/MinkowskiProductExtensions.lean` is the exact module path the description says it avoids because another open PR creates it.
